gold_provenance.note: The research agent that built this spike proposed these labels; the project owner reviewed all 28 and approved them unchanged on 2026-09-08. Accuracy measured against them is accuracy against human-reviewed labels, not against proposals. The agent did not approve its own work: authoring and review are recorded as separate facts and the approval originated outside this repository. Labels are still never sent to any model — the loader builds model input from the two texts alone.

historical.note: R0, R1 and R1.1 were measured against these labels while they were unconfirmed, and every figure published in those rounds is labelled provisional accuracy against proposed labels. Those rounds are kept as history and keep that wording.
